stories.title: Tissera picks positives in series defeat
stories.subTitle: Sri Lanka manager speaks out
stories.summary: Michael Tissera, the outgoing manager of the Sri Lankan team, has said Sri Lanka's defeat in the recent three-match series against Pakistan, in the Abu Dhabi, could be attributed to post World Cup fatigue

stories.title: Tissera quits as Sri Lanka manager
stories.subTitle: Two-year term ends in May
stories.seoTitle: Tissera quits as Sri Lanka manager
stories.summary: Michael Tissera's last assignment as manager will be Sri Lanka's three-ODI series against Pakistan between May 18 and 22

stories.title: Tissera named as Sri Lankan manager
stories.subTitle: Sri Lankan cricket
stories.summary: Sri Lanka have appointed Michael Tissera for a two-year term as Sri Lanka team manager.
